summary: A 15-year-old girl fell into Lake Creek, which flows into Twin Lakes; rescue attempts by her father and boyfriend failed; Lake County and Chaffee County SAR searched the banks with canine teams through high water and fast current until a passerby found her body Friday evening ~5 p.m.
location: Lake Creek at Twin Lakes, south of Leadville
responding_agency: Lake County Sheriff's Office / Lake County Search and Rescue
